summary: Preserve Node failure when CommonJS require targets an ESM graph containing top-level await.

target.notes: Current Node require(esm) rejects asynchronous ESM graphs with ERR_REQUIRE_ASYNC_MODULE rather than synchronously blocking.

semantics.error: ERR_REQUIRE_ASYNC_MODULE on supporting current Node profiles
semantics.async: must not synchronously wait for top-level await

caveats: Reuse async.top-level-await for ESM graph execution itself.
Node-version-specific require(esm) behavior must remain profile gated.

tests.name: direct top-level await rejects require
tests.input:
// a.mjs: await Promise.resolve(); export const x=1
// main.cjs: try{require('./a.mjs')}catch(e){console.log(e.code)}
tests.expected_behavior: prints ERR_REQUIRE_ASYNC_MODULE on current supporting Node versions

tests.name: async dependency also rejects
tests.expected_behavior: prints ERR_REQUIRE_ASYNC_MODULE on current supporting Node versions
